name: Variants
source:
Component(dsl: 1, id: "test/variants", name: "Variants", kind: Kind.section, description: "Rules",
    defaultVariant: isMobile() ? "compact" : "wide",
    options: [StringOption(name: "title", label: "Title", maxLength: 40, default: "Hello")],
    variants: [
      Variant(id: "compact", label: "Compact", options: [NumberOption(name: "size", label: "Size", min: 1, max: 50, default: 12)], build: Text(child: options.title, size: options.size)),
      Variant(id: "wide", label: "Wide", build: Text(child: options.title)),
      Variant(id: "compact", label: "Duplicate", build: Text(child: "dup")),
    ])
